title: One-input numeric reducers across raster bands, time and array field axes

entry_inventory.interpretation: Names only; this batch expands real contexts/parameters and does not increase registration or claim complete semantics/Google parity

precision_fixes: Centered/scaled dispersion handles adjacent large/small floats without intermediate moment loss
Legacy sample sd now uses the same robust numerical kernel, preserving denominator/undefined policies
Normalized product avoids transient overflow/underflow; bounded exact integer product prechecks output
Double first/last selection occurs before narrowing callbacks; array validity masks use a separate cube
implementation.alignment: Distinct observed items require exact selected STAC CRS/affine basis and integer-pixel offset proof, no implicit alignment from export settings; six-value transforms only
implementation.limits: Unchanged shared50000 steps, graph500 nodes, static Array rank8/cells10000/exact integer2^53, raster Array rank8/axis64/cells64, public output1MB; selected numeric trees only

Hand values for band/time/array combined statistics, same-day and repeated observations, sample/population denominators and NoData
Static arrays noncontiguous layouts, exact integers, product cancellation, adjacent Float64 stdDev
